function.name: update_state_priority
function.description: Call this once you've determined the caller's priority level. Requires the requestID returned by get_new_requestID. Optionally include an updated issue_description if you've learned more detail since Intake.

requestID.description: The id returned by get_new_requestID for this service request

priority.description: The assessed priority of this service request

issue_description.description: Updated concise description of the HVAC issue, if more detail was learned
